chunks: Do not argue with them by the Qur'an,
for the Qur'an is a carrier possessing many faces; you would say and they would say.
But argue with them by the Sunnah,
for they will not find from it an escape.
ai.seo_question: Why should one avoid arguing with the Kharijites using the Qur'an?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises Ibn Abbas to avoid using the Qur'an for debate with the Kharijites because the Qur'an has multiple interpretations (faces) allowing each side to claim validity. Instead, he instructs using the Sunnah, which is more definitive and from which the Kharijites cannot easily escape or find a loophole. This strategy leverages the Kharijites' own acceptance of the Qur'an while utilizing the established Prophetic practice (Sunnah) as a more concrete and less ambiguous proof, reflecting the historical context of their literalist yet selective approach to scripture.
